description: Returns the canonical manifest for a site version: paths, sha256, sizes, version, slug, and created_at, plus an Ed25519 signature. signature is null when the server has no signing key. Inputs: slug, and optional version. When version is omitted, the result is the live site. Public keys are published at /.well-known/deed-signing-keys.json. No token is required.

slug.description: Slug of the site, such as keen-shore-ab12. Any public site; ownership is not required.

version.description: Optional retained version, such as "v2". Omit for the live version.

name: get_manifest
title: Get a signed version manifest
